about: Hand-written texts of the kinds a memory receives as images: screenshots of chat and dashboards, receipts, slides, notes. `keys` are the strings memory must keep exactly (numbers, codes, names, dates). Rendered in-process by sharp (runner.ts); no binary fixtures.
